cohort: The study included women from the Coronary Artery Risk Development in Young Adults (CARDIA) cohort and the Tianjin GDM Observational Study, comparing those with and without a history of gestational diabetes mellitus.
finding: Chinese women with a history of GDM had a higher risk of incident type 2 diabetes within 5-10 years postpartum compared to African American and white women with GDM, with the highest risk observed in Chinese women with GDM.
